title: An agent fixes a clip from checker output alone
summary: A failing clip, the hub's contract checker, and an agent that may not look at a frame. It passes in two rounds and a blind reviewer scores the result higher.
verified: Ran on 2026-11-12 on an Apple M3 Max (64 GB, macOS), ffmpeg 7.1.1, tesseract for text reading. One Claude subagent as the fixer, one as the blind reviewer. The driver re-ran clipcheck on both committed clips.
runtime: about 2 s per clip to check, 9 s with text reading; the agent's fix loop took about 3.5 minutes
key_result: The agent reached CLIPCHECK: PASS in 2 fix rounds without looking at a frame. One blind reviewer scored the clip 6/12 before and 8/12 after (judgement, n = 1). An early false-positive rule also made the agent speed up a wipe that was fine.
threshold: Checker PASS within 4 fix rounds or 30 minutes, and the blind reviewer does not score the after clip lower than the before clip.
